verdict.rationale: Expensify markets automatic categorization, merchant capture via SmartScan, and spend-management/Smart Limits features that imply near-real-time visibility (expensify-docs-6, expensify-docs-10), but there's no dedicated evidence of a live dashboard broken down by team, category, and merchant on the day spend occurs. Community reports directly contradict the 'real-time, accurate' framing: users report ~70% of transactions are miscategorized and SmartScan can take ~20 minutes per receipt, undermining same-day accurate categorized visibility (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-4, expensify-comm-5). Missing for 10: a dedicated real-time spend dashboard/report by team-category-merchant, first-party evidence of same-day data availability, and independent confirmation that categorization is reliable enough for founder-level trust.
